retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast mirrored portrait featuring a subject in a bold geometric pattern dress against a split black-and-white background with vintage swash typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring a central vertical axis that mirrors a female subject wearing a floor-length, one-shoulder dress with a black-and-white distorted checkerboard pattern. The background is divided into vertical bands of solid black and white, creating a stark, graphic environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the mirrored figures and the central vertical divide
High contrast between the solid background blocks and the complex dress pattern
Integration of organic human form with rigid geometric backgrounds
Typographic placement in the upper right quadrant balancing the visual weight
coreInvariants: Distorted checkerboard or op-art textile pattern

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two identical full-length figures mirrored along a central vertical line, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical black line acting as the mirror plane.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the mirrored faces, follows the vertical lines of the dress downward, then moves to the typography in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black outer panels and white inner panels create a rhythmic vertical striping.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with no mid-tones in the background; soft grayscale shading only on the subject's skin.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick stems with thin hairlines
Exaggerated ball terminals and curly swashes on ascenders and descenders
Tight letter spacing with overlapping elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'V' and 'D' featuring large, circular swash flourishes
Lowercase 'y' with a deep, looping descender

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the solid black background panel

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative typeface used for all display text to maintain 1970s period accuracy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the iconic 70s heavy serif look with decorative flourishes.
Provides the correct period-specific weight and curve style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome studio portrait of a woman in a one-shoulder dress with a black and white distorted checkerboard pattern. Mirror the image vertically along a central axis. The background should consist of vertical stripes: black on the far left and right, and white in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add title text in the upper right corner using a white, heavy-weight 1970s swash script font. Ensure the text is right-aligned and stacked.

verificationChecks: Is the dress pattern a high-contrast geometric print?
Is the typography in a vintage swash style?
Is the color palette strictly black and white?

adjustableVariables: Width of the vertical background stripes
postGenerationChecks: Check for perfect mirroring of the subject.
Ensure the typography is white against the black background.
Verify the dress pattern is clearly defined and high-contrast.
Confirm the background vertical stripes are straight and clean.
recipe.reuseFormula: Mirrored Portrait + Op-Art Pattern + Vertical Stripe Background + 70s Swash Script = Retro Soul Aesthetic
